Private Function Show(e As Long, v As Variant) As String
    Dim i As Long, j As Long, t As String, d As Long
    If e <> 0 Then
        Show = "e" & e
    ElseIf IsArray(v) Then
        t = TypeName(v) & " "
        On Error Resume Next
        d = 0
        d = UBound(v, 2)
        If Err.Number <> 0 Then
            Err.Clear
            t = t & "[" & LBound(v) & ".." & UBound(v) & "]"
            For i = LBound(v) To UBound(v)
                t = t & " " & TypeName(v(i)) & ":" & CStr(v(i))
            Next
        Else
            t = t & "[" & LBound(v, 1) & ".." & UBound(v, 1) & "," & LBound(v, 2) & ".." & UBound(v, 2) & "]"
            For i = LBound(v, 1) To UBound(v, 1)
                For j = LBound(v, 2) To UBound(v, 2)
                    t = t & " " & TypeName(v(i, j)) & ":" & CStr(v(i, j))
                Next
            Next
        End If
        Show = t
    ElseIf IsObject(v) Then
        Show = "Object " & TypeName(v)
    ElseIf IsNull(v) Then
        Show = "Null"
    ElseIf IsEmpty(v) Then
        Show = "Empty"
    Else
        Show = TypeName(v) & " " & CStr(v)
    End If
End Function
